name: Chummy assistant
description: The default loop. One agent loop, like a coding agent's: the model works with tools, call after call, until it answers without one. It says what it's doing as it goes, plans with its own to-do list when the work has several steps, decides the one next step before each call and is told to do just that (shown in the run's pane: Sessions → the run's text button), reads CHUMMY.md from the folder for your instructions, and summarises the conversation when it gets long. If it stops with steps unchecked, it's sent back to finish (twice at most).

blocks.comment: The model works with tools until it's done.

blocks.comment: Adds the final answer to the response and ends the run.

blocks.label: Stop with error
blocks.comment: The run ends as failed, with the reason.

functions.name: Show what it says
functions.description: When the model calls tools, whatever it wrote alongside the calls ("I'll read the file first.") is shown to you, and any checklist in it becomes the to-do list. The exchange goes on unchanged.

functions.name: Decide what's next
functions.description: Before each Work call: a small call without tools looks at the request, the to-do list, the step until now and the newest part of the work, and decides the ONE next step, as a direct instruction. It's shown in the run's pane (Sessions → the run's text button) and kept as {{next}}: Work's system message names it as the current step and Work's Reminder sends it last, so the model stays on task. If the call fails, {{next}} says to carry on with the to-do list. The exchange passes through unchanged.

blocks.label: The newest part
blocks.comment: Keeps the newest 2,500 characters, so the prompt stays short.

blocks.label: Decide what's next
blocks.comment: A small extra call: one instruction.

blocks.comment: One line in the run's pane.

params.format: Carry on with the user's request: do the first unchecked item on the to-do list, or answer if it's done.

blocks.comment: No step decided: carry on with the to-do list.

notes.text: Steers the agent: one step at a time, decided fresh before each Work call, for you (in the pane) and for the model (as {{next}}, sent last by Work's Reminder). The function's Exchange output fires once all of this is done, so Work always sees the newest {{next}}.

functions.name: Report what went wrong
functions.description: When Work or Run tool fails, this gets the exchange with the failure as its last message. The model says in a sentence or two what went wrong and what it will do differently; that goes to the chat and the run's pane, and becomes {{next}} so the next step takes it into account. Then the failure is taken back out of the exchange (and any tool calls left waiting are answered as not run), and the exchange goes back to the start of the Agent loop to try again. After 3 failures in one run it gives up, and the run stops with the last error.

blocks.label: The failure
blocks.comment: The last user message: the failure.

params.format: It failed 3 times. The last time: {{last_error}}

blocks.label: Say what went wrong

params.reminder: In one or two short sentences: what went wrong, and what will you do differently on the next try? Don't call tools, and don't apologise.

blocks.comment: Sees the conversation with the failure at its end.

blocks.label: Show it
blocks.comment: Added to the response; the run carries on.

params.format: The last try failed: _INPUT1_ Take another way.

blocks.label: The step now
blocks.comment: {{next}}: Decide what's next sees it.

blocks.label: Answer waiting calls
blocks.comment: Tool calls left waiting are answered as not run, so the exchange is valid again.

notes.text: Failures are reported, not hidden: you see a line in the chat and the pane, the model's next step knows what went wrong, and the exchange goes back without the failure in it. Three failures in one run and it stops for real.

functions.name: Make room
functions.description: After each round of tool results: saves the latest work as {{progress}}, and if the conversation has reached the model's compaction point (Settings → Models: 80% of its context unless you change it), the model summarises it and the work carries on from the summary in a fresh exchange. If summarising fails, the conversation goes on as it was.

blocks.label: Save the progress
blocks.comment: {{progress}} keeps the newest 8,000 characters.

blocks.label: Context full?
blocks.comment: Estimated tokens (system message included) against the model's compaction point.

params.format:
Here is your work on the user's request so far:

_INPUT1_

It's getting long, so write a summary to carry on from. Include what the user asked for, what you've done, the key facts you found (file names, values, errors, decisions) and what's left to do, with your to-do list if you have one. Write only the summary, at most 25 short lines.

The user's request:
{{request}}

Your work on it so far, summarised to save room:
_INPUT1_

Carry on from where you left off.

blocks.label: Fresh exchange

params.system:
You are Chummy, a helpful assistant. You work in the user's folder using the tools you have, and you keep going until the user's request is done.

# How you work
- Text you write is shown to the user. Before you call tools, say in one short sentence what you're about to do.
- Use tools to look things up and to make changes. Read a file before you change it. Don't guess what you can check.
- When tool calls don't depend on each other, make them together.
- If a tool fails or the user doesn't allow a call, read why. Don't repeat the same call: try another way, or explain what's in the way.
- Do what was asked, no more. Change existing files rather than making new ones unless a new one is needed. To change part of a file, edit just that part (with edit_file, if you have it) instead of writing the whole file again.
- Long files and results come in parts. If a result says there's more, read on from where it says.
- Before anything hard to undo, like deleting or overwriting the user's work, ask the user first.
- If the request is unclear, ask one short question and stop there.

# Planning
For work with 3 or more steps, keep a to-do list. Write it as a checklist, one step per line:
- [ ] a step to do
- [x] a step that's done
Write the whole list again whenever it changes: when you make it, and each time you finish a step. Work on the first unchecked step. Make each step specific. For simple requests, skip the list and just do it.

# Finishing
When everything is done, check your work if you can (for example, read back a file you wrote). Then give your final answer, with no tool calls: short and direct, what you did and what came out. Be honest: if something failed or you couldn't check it, say so. Use Markdown when it helps; no emojis unless asked.

# Your to-do list now
{{todos}}

# Your current step
{{next}}
Work on this step only. Stay on the user's request: no side tasks. When the step is done, stop; the next one is decided for you.

# The user's folder (top level)
{{folder}}

# The user's instructions for this folder (CHUMMY.md)
{{instructions}}

# Conversation before this request
{{conversation}}

blocks.comment: The same instructions, then the summary.

params.format: _(The work so far got long, so I summarised it to make room.)_

blocks.label: If that fails
blocks.comment: Carry on with the long conversation.

notes.text: Like auto-compaction: a long conversation is summarised so the model's context doesn't overflow. When it happens is set per model in Settings → Models (Make room at), or here with Context full?'s own percentage.

functions.name: Done?
functions.description: When the model answers without tool calls. Keeps any checklist in the answer, then decides: an answer that ends with a question waits for you; an empty answer, or one given while the to-do list still has unchecked steps, is sent back to carry on (twice at most per message); anything else is the final answer.

blocks.label: Sent back twice?
blocks.comment: Twice already: take this answer.

blocks.label: Asks you?
blocks.comment: Ends with a question: the turn ends and your reply carries on.

blocks.label: Show what it said
blocks.comment: You still see what the model said.

notes.text: Not in the original loop, which simply stops when the model stops calling tools. Small models often stop half-way, so this sends them back (at most twice). Delete the Done? block in the Agent loop and link Answer straight out to get the original behaviour.

functions.name: Agent loop
functions.description: The core loop: before each call, Decide what's next picks the one next step (shown in the run's pane and sent to Work as its last message); then Work is called with the conversation so far; if it calls tools, what it said is shown, the calls run (your approvals apply) and the results go back to it; when it answers without tool calls, Done? decides whether that's the final answer. If Work or Run tool fails, Report what went wrong says why and the loop tries again from the start (3 times at most).

blocks.label: Start the exchange

notes.text: The core cycle: Decide what's next ⇄ Work ⇄ Show what it says ⇄ Run tool ⇄ Make room, until the model answers without tool calls. The loop's limits (model calls, tool calls) stop a model that never finishes.

Chummy assistant

1. Get ready: your request, the conversation, CHUMMY.md (your instructions for this folder) and the folder's top level.
2. Agent loop: one model does the work, one step at a time: before each call, Decide what's next picks the next step (shown in the run's pane) and Work is told to do just that. Each answer with tool calls: what it says is shown, the tools run, the results go back. Long conversations are summarised.
3. Planning: the model keeps its own checklist (- [ ] / - [x]) as {{todos}}.
4. Done? An answer without tool calls is the final answer, unless it's empty or steps are unchecked (then it's sent back, twice at most). A question for you ends the turn.
5. If Work or Run tool fails, the model says what went wrong (in the chat) and the loop tries again from the start, 3 times at most.
